source_caption:
Ke Huy Quan returned to acting after nearly two decades away for Everything Everywhere All at Once, delivering a heartfelt performance that earned him an Academy Award and became one of the most inspiring comeback stories in Hollywood.

Everything Everywhere All at Once (2022), directed by Daniel Kwan & Daniel Scheinert, starring Michelle Yeoh, Ke Huy Quan, Stephanie Hsu. A wildly inventive multiverse adventure that blends chaos, humor, and emotion into a powerful story about family, identity, and choosing connection in an infinite universe.

source_details.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
source_details.synopsis: Everything Everywhere All at Once is a 2022 American independent absurdist comedy-drama film written and directed by Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert, who produced it with Anthony and Joe Russo and Jonathan Wang. The film incorporates media from several genres, including surreal comedy, science fiction, fantasy, martial arts films, and immigrant narrative. Michelle Yeoh stars as Evelyn Quan Wang, a Chinese-American immigrant who, while being audited by the IRS, discovers that she must connect with parallel universe versions of herself to prevent a powerful being from destroying the multiverse. The film also stars Stephanie Hsu, Ke Huy Quan, James Hong, and Jamie Lee Curtis. Kwan and Scheiner
